run_print_num_configs: run the script to print the number of BUILDER_CONFIGS for a TensorFlow dataset
run_print_num_configs_dataset: run the script with a dataset name to count its builder configs
run_print_num_configs_tfds: run the script using tfds.builder to get config count for a dataset
run_print_num_configs_absl: run the script with absl flags to print dataset builder config count
run_print_num_configs_cli: run the CLI script with --dataset flag to print number of configs
